title: Focal Calibration Loss: Controlling Posterior Distortion in Deep Neural Classifiers
abstract: arXiv:2410.18321v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Confidence calibration matters wherever a classifier's probabilities, not just its labels, are consumed downstream. We study Focal Calibration Loss (FCL), which adds a squared probability-error (multiclass Brier) anchor to the focal objective, $\mathcal{L}{\mathrm{FCL}}^{\gamma,\lambda} = \mathcal{L}{\mathrm{focal}}^{\gamma} + \lambda |\hat{p}(x) - e_y|_2^2$. Our analysis separates two properties that are easily conflated: FCL is classification-calibrated for every $\gamma, \lambda \ge 0$, preserving the Bayes decision rule, yet for $\gamma > 0$ it is generally not proper, so its Bayes-optimal probability vector is displaced from the true posterior. The main result quantifies that displacement and shows the anchor controls it: bounded by $\sqrt{\log K / \lambda}$ for every posterior and minimizer without regularity assumptions, improving to $O(1/\lambda)$ for interior posteriors, with an exact first-order expansion identifying the bi

translated_title: 焦点校准损失：控制深度神经分类器中的后验失真
translated_abstract: 摘要：置信度校准在分类器的概率（而不仅仅是标签）被下游使用时至关重要。我们研究了焦点校准损失（FCL），它在焦点目标中加入了平方概率误差（多类Brier）锚定项，$\mathcal{L}{\mathrm{FCL}}^{\gamma,\lambda} = \mathcal{L}{\mathrm{focal}}^{\gamma} + \lambda |\hat{p}(x) - e_y|_2^2$。我们的分析区分了两个容易混淆的性质：FCL对于所有$\gamma, \lambda \ge 0$都是分类校准的，保留了贝叶斯决策规则，但对于$\gamma > 0$，它通常不是适当的，因此其贝叶斯最优概率向量会偏离真实后验。主要结果量化了这一偏离，并显示锚定项控制着它：对于每个后验和最小化器，在没有正则性假设的情况下，有界为$\sqrt{\log K / \lambda}$，对于内部后验改进为$O(1/\lambda)$，并且精确的一阶展开式识别了偏差。
tldr: 本文通过引入锚定项来控制焦点损失导致的概率后验失真，同时保持分类校准性，并提供了量化偏差的界限。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an anchor term to control posterior distortion caused by focal loss while preserving classification calibration, providing quantified bounds on the deviation.
